title: 多LLM代理系统动态治理实现协作对话结果
summary: 本文提出体验编排器（EO）治理层，用于多LLM代理对话系统。通过上下文Bandit、PID控制器和POMDP信念追踪，在6万次模拟中，高意图顾问联系率提升32个百分点（78.1% vs 46.1%），证明治理策略决定结果。
summary_en: This paper proposes an Experience Orchestrator (EO) governance layer for multi-LLM agent conversations. Using contextual bandit, PID controller, and POMDP belief tracking, it achieves a +32 percentage point lift in high-intent advisor contact rate (78.1% vs 46.1%) across 60,000 simulations, showing governance policy determines outcomes.
